description: Provisioned versus realized capacity per deployment, with p95 heap and disk utilization and the resulting wasted spend. This is the single best tool for finding over-provisioned Hosted deployments. Rows where utilization_data_missing is true have no node_stats, so utilization defaults to 100% and waste cannot be measured - that is expected for Serverless projects, which auto-scale.

configuration.query:
FROM billing_realized_pool_lookup
| EVAL billing_ts = @timestamp, billing_deployment_id = deployment_id, billing_deployment_name = deployment_name
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON composite_key
| EVAL ts = billing_ts
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", billing_ts, NOW()) <= ?days
| EVAL heap_util = CASE(heap_used_pct_p95 IS NULL, 100.0, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0, disk_util = CASE(disk_used_pct_p95 IS NULL, 100.0, disk_used_pct_p95) / 100.0
| EVAL w_sum = conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight, util_floor = COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor), 0.10)
| EVAL raw_utilization_score = CASE(w_sum > 0, (conf_utilization_memory_weight * heap_util + conf_utilization_storage_weight * disk_util) / w_sum, 1.0)
| EVAL utilization_score = CASE(raw_utilization_score < util_floor, util_floor, raw_utilization_score)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * CASE(utilization_score IS NULL, 1.0, utilization_score)
| EVAL rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL provisioned_cost = data_tier_capacity_ecu * rate, realized_cost = chargeable_pool * rate
| EVAL utilization_data_missing = heap_used_pct_p95 IS NULL AND disk_used_pct_p95 IS NULL
| STATS provisioned_cost = SUM(provisioned_cost), realized_cost = SUM(realized_cost), avg_heap_pct = AVG(heap_used_pct_p95), avg_disk_pct = AVG(disk_used_pct_p95), no_utilization_data = MAX(utilization_data_missing)
    BY deployment_id = billing_deployment_id, deployment_name = billing_deployment_name
| EVAL wasted_cost = provisioned_cost - realized_cost
| SORT wasted_cost DESC
| LIMIT 50
